source_name: Prozorro Bug Bounty / platform operations page (майданчикам)
why_relevant: Official page for authorised marketplaces — the authoritative route to the current list of authorised брокери/майданчики, which defines the complete set of legitimate mirror sources for UA tender data.

source_name: Ministry of Economy (Mineconomy) — official listing of procurement information sources and analytical tools
why_relevant: Government-published inventory titled 'Інформаційні джерела та аналітичні інструменти сфери публічних закупівель' — a state-sanctioned map of where procurement information lives, including third-party analytics. High-credibility seed for expanding the aggregator/monitoring cell beyond what search engines surface.

source_name: E-data Spending API documentation (Confluence) — 'Договори' parametric API
why_relevant: Official user manual for the contracts and transactions endpoints — defines fields, filters and semantics needed to build a reliable contract-execution collector.

source_name: Data.gov.ua organisation page — Державна казначейська служба України
why_relevant: Enumerates every dataset the Treasury publishes; the cheapest way to discover treasury datasets not yet on the radar (registers, classifiers, disposer directories).

source_name: DREAM — Digital Reconstruction Ecosystem for Accountable Management (promo/partners)
why_relevant: State ecosystem co-designed with RISE Ukraine, TI Ukraine, OCP and BRDO. The partners page is an efficient actor-map expander; the platform itself publishes project-level data that eventually links to procurement. Relevant where reconstruction budgets touch financial/digital infrastructure.

source_name: Open Data Toolkit — 'Як перевірити, чи має компанія заборону на участь у публічних закупівлях'
why_relevant: State-backed how-to that names the exact registers and steps for screening a procurement participant — a compact map of the screening source stack for this cell.

source_name: State Property Fund of Ukraine — authorised Prozorro.Sale platforms list (small privatisation)
why_relevant: Independent, government-maintained cross-check on which sale-side marketplaces are authorised. Useful for validating operator status when the marketplaces' own claims conflict, and for detecting accreditation changes.

source_name: Каталог фінтех-компаній України / Fintech Catalog (UAFIC annual catalogue, PDF)
why_relevant: A structured, downloadable enumeration of Ukrainian fintech companies with segment tags — the single richest one-shot vendor/actor list for the payments supply side. New editions are collected annually (Fintech Catalog 2026 call for entries open).

source_name: Ukrainian Fintech Awards
why_relevant: Nomination and shortlist pages enumerate fintech vendors and bank projects by category — a curated map of who has delivered what, useful for anticipating references in future tenders.

source_name: Oschadbank branch-level buyer profiles (regional управління, separate EDRPOUs)
why_relevant: Critically, Oschadbank procures not only under head-office EDRPOU 00032129 but under ~20 separate regional branch EDRPOUs (e.g. Dnipropetrovsk 09305480, Lviv 09325703, Poltava 09331508, Ternopil 09338500, Kyiv HQ region 09322277). Anyone filtering on the head-office code alone will miss a large slice of ATM/terminal consumables and branch equipment demand.

source_name: tender.uub.com.ua — Ukrainian Universal Exchange Prozorro marketplace (buyer directory)
why_relevant: The single most productive pointer found in this cell: it exposes stable /company-<EDRPOU>/ buyer directory URLs, which is how the Oschadbank branch network, Sense Bank, Ukrgasbank, Ukrposhta, NBU and the Banknote Mint were all enumerated. Good for actor discovery, not for bulk collection.

source_name: Асоціація ЄМА (EMA) — Члени / Members directory
why_relevant: EMA is the Ukrainian interbank association of payment-system members (banks, PSPs, payment systems, financial companies, MFOs). Its members page enumerates essentially the whole card/payments buyer universe in UA — the master actor list for every other A2 tender-monitoring cell.

source_name: Асоціація ЄМА — Партнери (vendor/partner page)
why_relevant: Partner list surfaces the supply side — technology vendors, processors, security and anti-fraud suppliers courting UA banks. Weak signal for who is positioning ahead of tenders.

source_name: YouControl catalogue of EDR-derived company data
why_relevant: Browsable catalogue of companies derived from the Unified State Register — useful for KVED-based enumeration (e.g. payment services, computer equipment wholesale) to build a candidate vendor universe before touching tender data.

source_name: European Business Association (Ukraine) — Electronic Payments Committee
why_relevant: EBA unites ~970 companies; the Electronic Payments Committee gathers members whose core business is banking and e-payments, and publishes positions/meetings with the NBU. Both an actor list and an early view of regulatory-driven spending.

source_name: YouControl — company profile, PrJSC Ukrainian Processing Centre (EDRPOU 24747867)
why_relevant: UPC is the largest independent processor and an early PROSTIR participant, but is a private JSC and therefore not a Prozorro buyer. Registry aggregators are the practical route to its ownership, financials and counterparty links.

source_name: Shelfy — Ukrainian system-integrator company directory
why_relevant: Directory listing integrators active in Ukraine with profiles — cheap way to enumerate mid/small integrators absent from the trade rankings, then snowball to their client pages.

source_name: YouControl / Opendatabot — association & member legal-entity resolver
why_relevant: Resolves association and member names to EDRPOU codes, founders and beneficiaries — the join key that turns an association member list into Prozorro buyer/supplier identifiers. Example shown: EMA (EDRPOU 30401000), UAFIC (42031209), NABU (37924657), UCBS (21573585).

source_name: Асоціація «Український кредитно-банківський союз» (УКБС / UCBS)
why_relevant: Third banking association, reported to unite ~92 financial-credit institutions including foreign representative offices — extends the actor map beyond the largest banks into mid-tier and non-bank financial institutions that also run procurement.

source_name: Асоціація українських банків (АУБ / AUB)
why_relevant: Second major banking association (founded 1990, EBF member). Its member roster and Council page (Рада АУБ) name banks plus the individual executives who chair procurement-relevant committees.

source_name: IT Ukraine Association — FinTech Committee
why_relevant: Committee membership names the IT service companies that build and integrate banking/payment systems in Ukraine — i.e. the likely bidders and subcontractors in bank tenders.

source_name: DOZORRO — procurement monitoring portal and tools index (TI Ukraine)
why_relevant: Civil-society monitoring layer over Prozorro plus a curated index of third-party analytics tools built on the open data. Best single pointer for discovering additional derived sources, and its feedback/risk content flags problematic tenders and suppliers.

source_name: DOZORRO community NGO directory (per-organisation monitoring profiles)
why_relevant: Per-NGO profile pages inside DOZORRO expose the network of regional civil-society monitors and what each one has flagged. The single best snowball vector for discovering smaller regional watchdogs that may cover local bank/payment-terminal procurements.

source_name: БМС Консалтінг / БМС Сервіс group — integrator supplying Ukrainian state banks
why_relevant: The BMS group is a recurrent supplier of datacentre/hardware to Ukrainian state banks (reported Oschadbank Dell data-centre contract ~UAH 223m). Registry/journalistic profiles of the group act as supply-side identification of who wins big bank infrastructure deals, and the related entities (БМС Сервіс, БМС-Лайн Сервіс) reveal the contracting structure.

source_name: VKURSI API repository (GitHub vkursi-pro/API)
why_relevant: Publicly documents the endpoint surface — tender analytics by period and by CPV, sanctions, founders by country, financial risk — letting us judge feasibility of automated supplier enumeration before buying access.

source_name: awesome835 — curated index of Ukrainian open-data tools and registries
why_relevant: Community-maintained list of every Ukrainian open-data registry, standard and tool. High-value snowballing seed for finding smaller aggregators and registry mirrors this cell has not yet enumerated.

source_name: API JSON Reader (APIJR) — third-party utility for the spending.gov.ua API
why_relevant: Community tool documenting practical query patterns against the E-data API for transactions, contracts and budget commitments — shortcut to correct endpoint usage and undocumented quirks.

source_name: Prozorro.Sale broker/marketplace directory (майданчики ЕТС Prozorro.Продажі)
why_relevant: Parallel accredited-operator network for the SALE/auction side. Directly banking-relevant: liquidated-bank asset sales (Deposit Guarantee Fund lots) and state property are sold through these brokers, exposing bank hardware/branch estates and the buyers who acquire them. Separate accreditation levels per broker are listed.

source_name: НАБУ / Національна (Незалежна) асоціація банків України — Банки-учасники
why_relevant: Member banks of NABU represent the overwhelming majority of Ukrainian banking assets. Canonical enumeration of bank buyers whose procurement (ATMs, cards, software, cash handling) is the A2 target. NOTE: acronym НАБУ is ambiguous with the anti-corruption bureau — noisy term.

source_name: AHK Ukraine (German-Ukrainian Chamber) — 'Закупівлі та тендери' donor tender guide
why_relevant: Curated Ukrainian-language directory explaining that UA contracting authorities receiving EBRD/World Bank/EIB loans procure under donor rules rather than national law, and pointing to each donor's portal. Excellent snowball map of donor procurement entry points for a local audience.

source_name: Opendatabot API documentation
why_relevant: Documents programmatic access to EDR/USR and related registers — the machine-readable route to building a supplier universe and monitoring changes (ownership, liquidation, directors) for banking/payments vendors.

source_name: PayAtlas — Ukraine country and company profiles
why_relevant: English-language structured profiles of Ukrainian PSPs and acceptance methods, including per-company pages (e.g. IBoxBank). Useful for cross-checking English names and for a foreign-analyst view of the acceptance landscape.

source_name: PSP/e-commerce comparison guides (cityhost, KITAPP, solomono, buh.ua)
why_relevant: Merchant-facing comparison articles enumerate the live PSP set (LiqPay, Portmone, Fondy, WayForPay, Interkassa, EasyPay, PROSTIR, 4bill) with fee structures — a cheap, continuously refreshed roster for building the actor map and spotting new entrants/exits.

source_name: Ukraine-Britain Business Council — outline of IFI-financed procurement opportunities in Ukraine
why_relevant: Maps the actual landscape of IFI-financed procurement channels in Ukraine, naming Prozorro plus RELINK, REPOWER, DREAM and PREPARE alongside EBRD and World Bank portals — a compact actor/portal map for this cell and the origin of several leads to verify.

source_name: «Мережі та Бізнес» — annual Ukrainian system-integrator ranking (SI Ukraine)
why_relevant: Trade-press ranking that enumerates the entire Ukrainian system-integrator field with revenue and specialisation — the single best pointer for building the bidder universe for bank IT tenders, and for spotting new entrants year over year.

source_name: Громадський Простір — каталог організацій (TIU, StateWatch profiles)
why_relevant: Ukrainian civil-society aggregator carrying announcements and organisational profiles for procurement watchdogs. Useful redundancy channel when the NGOs' own sites are WAF-blocked, and a discovery route to lesser-known analytical centres.
